title: A record_header action cannot show per-reader state (an active / pressed predicate)
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. The order on #27434 said: triage rows 1–7, TAKE what is ui-only, CARD the rest. The card thread measured each row on `origin/main` `e41642dd` (report 6515174308, `out_of_scope_findings`).
Reach: a record page header action the reader toggles, such as HotCRM `mark_article_helpful` / `mark_article_not_helpful` on a knowledge article.
Reader who acts: `domain:spec` first (the key), then `domain:ui` (header buttons draw it).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "header action pressed active state per user toggle aria-pressed" → no results.

## Observed
A header action button cannot tell the reader they already acted ("you voted Helpful"). `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` has no per-reader state key.

## Wanted
An optional per-reader predicate on `ActionSchema` (`active` or `pressed`, a CEL expression over `record` and `user`). The spec half is the key, its expression lint and docs. The ui half (a follow-up `domain:ui` card) is `page:header` buttons and `DeclaredActionsBar` drawing it as `aria-pressed` with a pressed face.

Dedupe words: action pressed state, toggle action active, per-user action state, aria-pressed header action.

Related: #27434 (row 5).
